Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Placements: d4builds A 'Thorns' (Shield Charge icon, no guide page) [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16]; InfinityBuilds A 'Shield Bash' - '[S15/Thorns·Shield Bash]' by Mr.Gong, the same Thorns family with Shield Bash and Razorplate in place of Shield Charge and Mantle of the Grey [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16]; Maxroll A endgame (3rd in A) and A push (17th) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]. It is the only Paladin family A on all three. Maxroll is the construction source despite ranking third in weight because the two higher-weighted sites publish no internals for this build (d4builds has no page; InfinityBuilds' Shield Bash page lists items and one or two affixes only) [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/su4bft0q - 2026-09-16]. Recorded alternative, InfinityBuilds' Shield Bash variant: Leoric's Crown, Razorplate, Fists of Fate, Griswold's Opus, Herald of Zakarum, Stone of Jordan, Blood-Mad Idol, pants Aspect of Spiked Armor [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/builds/tu8ZECWU6O - 2026-09-16]. Maxroll: 'Shield Charge is one of the best all-rounders that the Paladin has at its disposal for melting T12 content' (planner intro). Damage is Physical Thorns from direct hits and Retribution on block; Hit Count As Blocking makes charging through packs count as blocks. 3.2.1: Juggernaut's Oath 80% to 100%; Shield of Retribution Thorns scale with ranks (not used here); Tibault's Will regeneration 50% to 25%; Leoric's Crown feed value 35-50%[x] vs PTR 75-100% (unverified, re-verify) [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394 - 2026-09-16]. No Season 15 push profile: Maxroll's Season 15 guide dropped the Push variant, so the pushing stage repeats the Endgame kit; Maxroll still places Shield Charge A on push. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game.

Rotation
  1. Channel Shield Charge through packs so hits count as blocks and Retribution pulses; Clash at least every 6 seconds to keep Crusader's March; Fortress for 3 seconds of immunity and its Resolve damage bonus; Condemn to gather; Defiance Aura for Unstoppable.
Variants

Leveling — Shield Charge through as many enemies as possible; Clash every 6 s; Fortress for immunity and damage; Condemn to gather and apply Vulnerable/Weaken; Aegis on cooldown; Defiance Aura for Unstoppable. [Maxroll su4bft0q, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Switch to Midgame when Leoric's Crown, Mantle of the Grey, Herald of Zakarum and Tibault's Will are equipped and Fanaticism Aura can replace Aegis.

Early Endgame — Shield Charge through packs; Clash every 6 s; Fortress for immunity and damage; Condemn to gather; Defiance Aura for Unstoppable. Fanaticism Aura supplies Critical Strike Chance (14% at 15 ranks) and Rite of Vengeance crit damage; no need to cast it. [Maxroll su4bft0q, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Move to Endgame when Blood-Mad Idol (Mythic), Penitent Greaves and Seal of the Diamond Mind are in hand.

Late Endgame — Shield Charge through packs; Clash every 6 s; Fortress for immunity and damage; Condemn to gather; Defiance Aura for Unstoppable; Fanaticism Aura supplies Critical Strike Chance passively. [Maxroll su4bft0q, 2026-09-16]
Move on when No Season 15 push variant is published; move to the pushing stage only as a mindset - same kit, Abyssal splinters everywhere, Resolve-stack tempers masterworked.

Pushing — Shield Charge through packs; Clash every 6 s; Fortress for immunity and damage; Condemn to gather; Defiance Aura for Unstoppable; Fanaticism Aura supplies Critical Strike Chance passively. [Maxroll su4bft0q, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Final stage.

How to run them

Maxroll su4bft0q (2026-09-16): hired Subo 'to reveal your map with his Seeker ability'; Cover Fire with Opening Fire occasionally raises Critical Strike Damage. Build Notes (Shared for all Variants)

Placements: d4builds A 'Thorns' (Shield Charge icon, no guide page) [https://d4builds.gg/tierlist/ - 2026-09-16]; InfinityBuilds A 'Shield Bash' - '[S15/Thorns·Shield Bash]' by Mr.Gong, the same Thorns family with Shield Bash and Razorplate in place of Shield Charge and Mantle of the Grey [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/tier-list - 2026-09-16]; Maxroll A endgame (3rd in A) and A push (17th) [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/endgame-tier-list - 2026-09-16] [https://maxroll.gg/d4/tierlists/push-tier-list - 2026-09-16]. It is the only Paladin family A on all three. Maxroll is the construction source despite ranking third in weight because the two higher-weighted sites publish no internals for this build (d4builds has no page; InfinityBuilds' Shield Bash page lists items and one or two affixes only) [https://planners.maxroll.gg/profiles/d4/su4bft0q - 2026-09-16]. Recorded alternative, InfinityBuilds' Shield Bash variant: Leoric's Crown, Razorplate, Fists of Fate, Griswold's Opus, Herald of Zakarum, Stone of Jordan, Blood-Mad Idol, pants Aspect of Spiked Armor [https://infinitybuilds.gg/en/builds/tu8ZECWU6O - 2026-09-16]. Maxroll: 'Shield Charge is one of the best all-rounders that the Paladin has at its disposal for melting T12 content' (planner intro). Damage is Physical Thorns from direct hits and Retribution on block; Hit Count As Blocking makes charging through packs count as blocks. 3.2.1: Juggernaut's Oath 80% to 100%; Shield of Retribution Thorns scale with ranks (not used here); Tibault's Will regeneration 50% to 25%; Leoric's Crown feed value 35-50%[x] vs PTR 75-100% (unverified, re-verify) [https://news.blizzard.com/en-us/article/24295394 - 2026-09-16]. No Season 15 push profile: Maxroll's Season 15 guide dropped the Push variant, so the pushing stage repeats the Endgame kit; Maxroll still places Shield Charge A on push. Soul Splinter cap caveat: the official text is 'You can equip up to three Soul Splinters among available Jewelry slots' and Leoric's Crown counts as Jewelry, yet every Season 15 reference loadout read on 2026-09-16 sockets more than three - unverified, re-verify in game.

Rotation
  1. Channel Shield Charge through packs so hits count as blocks and Retribution pulses; Clash at least every 6 seconds to keep Crusader's March; Fortress for 3 seconds of immunity and its Resolve damage bonus; Condemn to gather; Defiance Aura for Unstoppable.
Variants

Leveling — Shield Charge through as many enemies as possible; Clash every 6 s; Fortress for immunity and damage; Condemn to gather and apply Vulnerable/Weaken; Aegis on cooldown; Defiance Aura for Unstoppable. [Maxroll su4bft0q, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Switch to Midgame when Leoric's Crown, Mantle of the Grey, Herald of Zakarum and Tibault's Will are equipped and Fanaticism Aura can replace Aegis.

Early Endgame — Shield Charge through packs; Clash every 6 s; Fortress for immunity and damage; Condemn to gather; Defiance Aura for Unstoppable. Fanaticism Aura supplies Critical Strike Chance (14% at 15 ranks) and Rite of Vengeance crit damage; no need to cast it. [Maxroll su4bft0q, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Move to Endgame when Blood-Mad Idol (Mythic), Penitent Greaves and Seal of the Diamond Mind are in hand.

Late Endgame — Shield Charge through packs; Clash every 6 s; Fortress for immunity and damage; Condemn to gather; Defiance Aura for Unstoppable; Fanaticism Aura supplies Critical Strike Chance passively. [Maxroll su4bft0q, 2026-09-16]
Move on when No Season 15 push variant is published; move to the pushing stage only as a mindset - same kit, Abyssal splinters everywhere, Resolve-stack tempers masterworked.

Pushing — Shield Charge through packs; Clash every 6 s; Fortress for immunity and damage; Condemn to gather; Defiance Aura for Unstoppable; Fanaticism Aura supplies Critical Strike Chance passively. [Maxroll su4bft0q, 2026-09-16]
Move on when Final stage.
